conclusion: The direct terminal alone lost stdout after exit, but a script-written JSON file supplied a durable structured receipt. A fresh agentless terminal retrieved and decoded that receipt after a home Orca restart. P11's test obligation passed for this file-backed composition; a production adapter would have to implement and validate this two-terminal recovery path.
